object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time activation for ${entitlementName} on behalf of ${requestedForIdentityName} was extended for an additional ${extensionDuration}.

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies a manager, requester, or other interested party that a Just-In-Time activation window was extended on behalf of another identity.
object.id: [Default] Just-In-Time Activation Extended for Requested-For Identity

object.subject: Just-In-Time Activation Extended for ${requestedForIdentityName}
